name: BFUSD
oneLiner: BFUSD is a Binance account product redeemable inside Binance against USD stablecoins, backed by an opaque collateral pool and hedging portfolio.
collateral: Delta-hedged crypto positions (spot crypto such as ETH offset by equal short futures to collect funding fees), staked crypto (e.g. ETH staking via Binance Earn), and a USDT-seeded BFUSD Reserve Fund (~1.1M USDT, ~105% collateral value ratio at Nov 2024 launch); all assets are legally and beneficially owned by Binance, with no holder claim
pegMechanism: Binance account product purchased and redeemed 1:1 against supported USD stablecoins inside Binance, with Binance-controlled fees, limits, delays, and suspension rights

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: SONG-5 Safety Score V9 mechanism review
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Binance describes BFUSD as an account product backed by a managed collateral, hedging, staking, and reserve-fund strategy, which supports the synthetic-delta-neutral classification; current strategy assurance and allocation semantics remain undisclosed.

oracleRisk.summary: BFUSD is a Binance account balance backed by Binance-managed hedging, staking, and reserve-fund strategies rather than an onchain borrower market with a public collateral oracle.

branchApplicability.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 data research
branchApplicability.rationale: Binance describes BFUSD as a non-withdrawable, balance-based platform product purchased and redeemed against supported USD stablecoins. Binance manages the backing strategies and may delay redemption; holders do not open collateralized debt positions and no onchain collateral-liquidation branches exist for V9 to inventory.

reserveReview.rationale: Binance identifies the BFUSD collateral pool, hedging portfolio, and reserve fund but does not publish a dated constituent allocation or current custody and provider split.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The full BFUSD collateral, hedge, and reserve-fund composition and allocation are undisclosed.

nonLinkDispositions.reserveName: Binance BFUSD collateral pool, hedging portfolio, and reserve fund
nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Binance describes the aggregate product envelope but does not publish the current underlying assets, weights, or failure-domain identity.

notices.title: Binance account product
notices.message: BFUSD is not a withdrawable on-chain token in Pharos metadata. Reserve and redemption claims depend on Binance product terms and account eligibility rather than independently verifiable collateral.

mintAuthority.summary: BFUSD is a Binance account product, not a withdrawable on-chain token; Binance creates and redeems BFUSD on its internal exchange ledger 1:1 against supported USD stablecoins, controlling fees, limits, delays, and suspension rights, with no public on-chain mint contract.

controls.label: Binance BFUSD product ledger
controls.evidence: Binance creates/redeems BFUSD inside its centralized exchange against an opaque collateral pool and hedging portfolio; supply, fees, limits, and suspension are fully Binance-controlled. No public on-chain mint contract is exposed in Pharos metadata.

review.evidence: Binance BFUSD terms describe an exchange account product redeemable 1:1 inside Binance against USD stablecoins, with Binance-controlled supply, fees, limits, and suspension; it is not a withdrawable on-chain token and exposes no public mint contract.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Classified as an off-chain exchange-ledger product per Binance terms; there is no public on-chain mint contract or token owner to resolve.
unresolvedQuestions: BFUSD has no on-chain contract in Pharos metadata; the entire mint path is Binance's internal exchange ledger. If Binance later exposes an on-chain token contract, resolve its owner/minter admin at that time.

listingStatusReview.reason: Out of scope: BFUSD is a non-withdrawable Binance account balance rather than a transferable production token.
